scope: P3b.4/P3b.5 committed receipts (U1 engine-site, U2 write-window, fixture-qualification) that tools/verify_gen2_release.py's live-new-gates lane binds without touching the emulator. This file does NOT cover R-1/R-2/R-3/R-4/R-5g: that evidence has no committed receipt and comes only from a fresh SLINK_LIVE=1 pytest tests/live/test_gen2_new_gates.py run, which the lane runs directly once every row here is clean.
coverage_policy: A row passes only on a registered proof whose committed receipt matches its pinned sha256 and validates through the production Lua validator (engine_sites, write_window) or its own passed/physical_qualification fields (qualification). Empty proofs are explicit release blockers.
proof_hash_policy: Receipt SHA256 normalizes CRLF to LF (Windows checkouts use core.autocrlf).
